name: sqlty
description: Type-check the SQL in your Python code as you type

untrustedWorkspaces.description: sqlty runs the sqlty of the workspace's environment.

sqlty.path.markdownDescription: `sqlty` executables to try first, for example `["~/.local/bin/sqlty"]`.

sqlty.interpreter.markdownDescription: The Python interpreter whose `sqlty` runs. Empty: the interpreter selected in the Python extension.

sqlty.breaking.against.markdownDescription: A baseline for `sqlty breaking`: a git revision such as `main`, a snapshot `sqlty breaking --save` wrote, or schema files. Empty: no breaking checks.

enumDescriptions: Your queries against the schema of the baseline: deploy first.
The baseline's queries against your schema: migrate first.
sqlty.breaking.direction.markdownDescription: Which way `#sqlty.breaking.against#` is checked, as `sqlty breaking --direction`.

sqlty.trace.server.markdownDescription: Log the messages between VS Code and `sqlty server` in the output channel.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build-test && vscode-test
scripts.package: npm run build -- --minify && cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE && vsce package
